Quick heads-up on the likely redline items we will prioritize on the call:
- Liability cap: propose carve-outs for Third-party data processors and gross negligence threshold.
- Data retention & deletion: clarify retention period for KV cache logs and audit log storage.
- SLA credits: narrow scope to inference availability (not development support).

I'll upload an annotated MSA with tracked changes (MSA_Legal_annotated_v3.docx) into the shared Drive prior to the call; that should speed the line-by-line. If Meditech can flag any "must-have" clauses in the doc before we start, we can triage accordingly.
